title: [Noisy Crown] Hanakanmuri Circle [English][Doritto]
description:
![Image](http://damimage.com/upload/small/2015/09/05/55eaccc731ab2.jpg)  
  
Title: Hanakanmuri Circle  
Original title: ハナカンムリ○  
Year: Japan [2011-11-27](http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087067.html), English translation 2015-09-04  
Developer: [Noisy Crown](http://www.noisycrown.sakura.ne.jp/hanamaru.html)  
Translation: Doritto  
Language: English  
Voice: Japanese  
  
  
Description:  
A hyper-cute chibi platformer with a gruesome, lewd underside.  
  
In this vastly improved remake of Hanakanmuri, Fia must rescue her parents from a deep cave in the middle of a dangerous jungle. She will encounter various deadly monsters and make several new friends.  
  
To get through the world, Fia eats a lot of fruit and uses the power of Charming to turn enemies into friends. They will then reward her with items, high jumps, hugs etc.  
  
In-gameplay H/ryona content includes a clothes destruction and injury system, and various grab animations for enemies. There are 36 different game over scenes with CG art and voice acting for Fia. Horrible fates of being strangled, punched, stabbed, digested, chewed and raped to death await her.   
  
This release fully translates all story events, game overs, menus, letters, and item descriptions in the game. Some text, most notably the stage names, is untranslated; the release contains external translations for those.  
  
As a bonus 4 extra gory death scenes from Hanakanmuri If are included.  
  
Important:  
1. You need to extract the .zip with Japanese locale. If you don't, the audio won't work.  
2. For easiest startup on windows, run Hanakanmuri Circle.bat.  
  
The game itself is a .swf file that can be run in any program that supports flash. Adobe's own standalone flash projector is recommended. The folder includes the projector for Windows, and a .bat file that opens the game in the projector.  
  
If running the game in another program, you run the risk of having the wrong window size. (The correct is 640x480. The projector handles this automatically.) This causes some gameplay problems, most notably impending the player character's movement. Additionally, some flash plugins have some trouble loading resources. Use your own judgment.

This is the providence of nature!   
  
 Orcs have few females, so they use elves to multiply their brethren.   
  
 In this story, captive elf Aslin is "gifted" to orc warrior Mokkos for 2 years.   
 He may have her exclusively for that time, and his duty is vital: to make children.   
 After those 2 years Aslin will be offered to all the orcs for further breeding.   
  
 Be a man (orc!) and make Aslin your obedient slave!   
  
 Cast:   
 Aslin (CV: Honoka Sakura)   
 Other females (CVs: Himeno Shirayuki, Shion)

 Planning by a-MODEL

 Official URL here!  
http://www.alpha-model.jp/elf.html



  
 ■これは自然の摂理だ!  
  
 牝のいないオークにとって、エルフの牝の子袋は  
 同族を増やすための道具!  
  
 エルフの集落を襲って孕み頃の牝を掻っさらえ!!  
  
 ■雌エルフは部族の共有財産だ!  
  
 拉致された雌エルフは、部族のエリートオークに与えられ  
 専属の嫁として牝穴と子袋を開発されつつ二年の時を過ごす。  
  
 専属嫁を従順な繁殖奴隷へと仕立て上げ、  
 その妊娠能力を証明するのは、夫となったオークの大事な仕事。  
  
 二年余の新婚期間が終われば、雌エルフは家畜小屋に移されて  
 無数のオークたちから代わる代わるに子種を注がれ、  
 部族の繁殖に貢献していくことになる。  
  
 ■モッコスよ、アスリンを一人前の繁殖奴隷にしてみせろ!  
  
 オークの戦士モッコスは、自分に与えられた初めての専属嫁  
 アスリンを孕ませることができるのか!?  
  
 ……アスリン、オメェはオラの専用繁殖奴隷だべ!!

You can see another development or ending with this collection!  
  
The Group Sex Club: Maki and Shiori Edition  
"What if Maki and Shiori are attacked by the evil desire in the future where the hero is gone?"  
  
The Group Sex Club: Tomomi Edition  
"What if Tomomi, designated as a shrine maiden, could live through the gangbang?"  
  
The Group Sex Club: Chiaki Edition

description:
\[RPG\] \[玉藻スタジオ\] 閃光の騎士 ～カリスティアナイト～ / \[Tamamo Studio\] Carystia Knight Ver.1.07  
  
[![Image](http://imgmega.com/i/00156/aunljey3afgy_t.jpg)](http://imgmega.com/aunljey3afgy/RJ160110.jpg.html)  
  
Information:   
[DLsite](http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ159100.html)  
Title / タイトル: 閃光の騎士 ～カリスティアナイト～ / Carystia Knight  
Brand / ブランド: 玉藻スタジオ / Tamamo Studio  
Release / 販売日: 2015/07/24  
File size / ファイル容量: 1.98 GB  
  
[![Image](http://imgdrive.co/i/00032/gasi8xd7puwe_t.jpg)](http://imgdrive.co/gasi8xd7puwe/RJ160110_01.jpg.html) [![Image](http://main.imgclick.net/i/00619/tr26tzz4euzh_t.jpg)](http://imgclick.net/tr26tzz4euzh/RJ160110_02.jpg.html) [![Image](http://raptor.imgtrex.com/i/01097/560a2qftsfwg_t.jpg)](http://imgtrex.com/560a2qftsfwg/RJ160110_03.jpg) [![Image](http://imgmega.com/i/00156/a5kr29ndurbx_t.jpg)](http://imgmega.com/a5kr29ndurbx/RJ160110_04.jpg.html)  
  
\* Game \*   
 Carystia Knight is a 2D sidescrolling dungeon action-battle RPG.   
 Play as chibi heroes against a massively diverse roster of 100+ enemies.   
 Gameplay is fine-tuned for fans of the beat-em-up arcade and platform genres,   
 while also providing beginners and non-fans of platforming with a helpful   
 "slow fall" item that floats jumps in an easy, controllable way.   
  
 \* Contents \*   
 Events: 32 (300+ CGs incl. variations)   
 Pose art: 400+ artworks incl. variants   
 Display: 1280x720 resolution   
 Voice acting: 4500+ words   
 Game size: about 2GB   
  
 \* Story \*   
 While on a deep space exploration mission aboard the mining vessel Crouton,   
 Aika discovered a planet of "lost emigrants" who had long ago departed from Earth.   
 The planet was growing Carystium, which was against federal regulations.   
 Having lost her homeworld over Carystium, Aika landed on this free world to explore.   
  
 Meanwhile, Cerald of this free world was training to become a "Carystia Knight"   
 for the sake of parents stricken by a strange illness.   
 Cerald and Aika met by chance, they joined hands in the journey to the Carystium-rich city of Krotovuria.   
  
 \* Other \*   
 Sample voice and game details can be found on Tamamo Studio's official site  
http://tamamo.xii.jp



  
  
 ■ゲーム内容  
 2Dスクロールダンジョンとアクション性ある戦闘が味わえます。  
 100種以上のモンスターと主人公達のちびキャラが動き回ります。  
 2Dスクロールダンジョンではジャンプが苦手な方のために、ボタン押しっぱなしで落下速度を低下させるアイテムもあります。  
  
 基本イベントCG32枚、差分込み300枚以上  
 立ち絵差分400枚以上  
 解像度1280×720  
 ボイス数4500ワード以上  
 大容量約1.8GB  
  
 ■あらすじ  
 鉱石採掘船クルトンに乗って辺境宇宙を探索していたアイカは、かつて地球を移民船で旅立った人たちの子孫「ロストエミグラント」の星を見つける。  
 その星では連邦法で禁止されている閃光石鉱脈の培養が行われていた。  
 かつて故郷の星を閃光石培養で失ったアイカは、制止を振り切って星へと降り立つのだった。  
  
 一方、その星ではシェラルドが謎の病気にかかった両親を救うため、「閃光の騎士」になるための修行をしていた。  
 シェラルドとアイカは偶然に出会い、共に閃光石鉱脈の街クロトブリアへと向かうのだった。  
  
 ■その他  
 サンプルボイスやより詳細な情報は玉藻スタジオまでお越しください。  
http://tamamo.xii.jp
